🚀 Master Delta Live Tables (DLT) – The Future of ETL!
Building scalable, reliable, and maintainable ETL pipelines is now easier than ever with Delta Live Tables (DLT) in Databricks! This powerful framework automates data ingestion, transformation, and governance on Delta Lake, helping you streamline your Data Lakehouse workflows.
💡 Key Concepts You Should Know:
🔹 Medallion Architecture – Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers
🔹 Multi-Hop in the Lakehouse – Structuring efficient data flows
🔹 Live Tables & Streaming Live Tables – Real-time & batch processing
🔹 Spark Structured Streaming – Handling streaming data seamlessly
🔹 Data Quality & Change Data Capture (CDC) – Ensuring accuracy & consistency
🔹 Automated Data Management – Reducing manual effort

ai_analysis.summary: This promotional post introduces Delta Live Tables (DLT) in Databricks as a framework for automating data ingestion, transformation, and governance on Delta Lake. It highlights scalable ETL and lakehouse workflows, the Bronze-Silver-Gold medallion architecture, multi-hop data flows, batch and real-time processing with Live Tables and Streaming Live Tables, Spark Structured Streaming, data quality, change data capture, and automated data management. It provides a high-level concept list rather than implementation details, code, configuration guidance, or the contents of the referenced guide.

interview_questions.question: What data engineering activities does Delta Live Tables automate in Databricks?
interview_questions.answer:
Delta Live Tables automates data ingestion and transformation on Delta Lake.
The post also associates DLT with governance and more maintainable ETL workflows.

interview_questions.question: Which layers are identified as part of the medallion architecture?
interview_questions.answer:
The medallion architecture consists of Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
The post presents these layers as part of organizing lakehouse data flows.

interview_questions.question: How does the post describe multi-hop processing in a lakehouse?
interview_questions.answer:
Multi-hop is described as a way to structure efficient data flows within a lakehouse.
The post does not provide a concrete multi-hop pipeline example.

interview_questions.question: Which capabilities does the post associate with data quality and change data capture?
interview_questions.answer: Data quality and change data capture are associated with ensuring data accuracy and consistency.

interview_questions.question: A Databricks team wants to automate ETL activities on Delta Lake while supporting governance and different processing modes. Which framework and capabilities from the post are relevant?
interview_questions.answer:
Delta Live Tables is the relevant framework because the post describes it as automating ingestion, transformation, and governance on Delta Lake.
Live Tables and Streaming Live Tables are relevant to real-time and batch processing.
Automated data management can reduce manual effort, while data quality and change data capture support accuracy and consistency.
